title: ETH main building
notes: Another day at ETH. Lectures are finished. Now you need somewhere to study.

title: Looking for a seat
notes: You walk through the buildings looking for a free seat.

title: First room taken
notes: The first room is full.

title: Second room taken
notes: So is the next one.

title: Giving up
notes: You have spent your time finding a seat instead of studying.

title: A moment of privacy
notes: There has to be an easier way.

title: Book a seat from the toilet
notes: Check availability across the whole campus. Book a seat from the toilet.

title: Study Spaces Home
notes: Find a study space on Home or explore the campus map.

title: Campus availability
notes: See workspaces across ETH and explore the floors in 3D.

title: Choose a free seat
notes: Pick a free seat in the room layout.

title: Seat reserved
notes: The seat is held while you go there. Check in before the reservation expires.

title: Live teammate check-in
notes: The live demonstration moves to the teammate's phone and camera feed.

title: Scan the seat QR code
notes: Each seat has its own QR code. Scanning the matching code confirms arrival and starts the session.

title: Checked in
notes: The check-in starts the study session. The seat is now yours.

title: QR check-in
notes: QR check-in starts the session when the student reaches the seat.

title: Session limits and extension priority
notes: Sessions are limited. The current student gets the first chance to extend.

title: Handovers
notes: A handover helps the next student take over the seat.

title: Timed breaks
notes: A timed break lets you get a coffee without holding the seat indefinitely.

title: Study together
notes: Create a study group and find seats together with friends.

title: Built for ETH
notes: ETH sign-in, campus-specific access and a 3D campus map. Free for students. University administration makes the system official and authoritative.

title: One library
notes: Start with a pilot in one library.

title: Entire ETH
notes: Admins map rooms and seats in the admin panel. Expand the pilot across ETH.

title: Other universities
notes: The system can work at other universities. Each university makes it official and authoritative.

title: Study Spaces
notes: Less stress and less wandering. More time studying, together.
